def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   col=g[r][c]
   if not col or col==8 or (r,c) in seen: continue
   st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
   while st:
    x,y=st.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
    for z in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
     a,b=z
     if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and g[a][b]==col and z not in seen: seen.add(z);st.append(z)
   comps.append((col,comp))
 out=[row[:] for row in g]
 # clear all moving cells
 for _,co in comps:
  for r,c in co: out[r][c]=0
 # translate each right, treating 8 + components as obstacles and already placed comps
 for col,co in comps:
  d=0
  while True:
   nd=d+1
   if any(c+nd>=w for r,c in co): break
   if any(g[r][c+nd] == 8 for r,c in co): break
   # collisions with already placed objects
   if any(out[r][c+nd] for r,c in co): break
   d=nd
  for r,c in co: out[r][c+d]=col
 return out
